name: Detail Pressing (Web)
implementation_notes: Reuses PressingRecordService::getDetail() (BE service shared with screen-050, see that screen's implement artifact for the service/controller/route files)

Target Operasional table queried DIRECTLY by DetailPressing::render() (PressingOperationalTarget::orderBy('sort_order')->get()) -- NOT part of the GET /api/pressing-records/{id} response -- per this screen's tech-spec direction, mirrors DetailThreshing (screen-053) exactly

Field grouping/order in the Blade view mirrors mobile/src/views/DataPreviewPressingView.vue's detail mode exactly (Presser ID, Tanggal, Inputted By, Checked By, Acknowledged By, Note, grid, Target Operasional table), per explicit product direction that web station screens mirror mobile flow/UX
Route /data/pressing/{id} registered after /data/pressing/create (screen-058) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}

REVISED 2026-08-24 (documentation-only correction, no functional code change needed): the Blade view (detail-pressing.blade.php) already iterated $record['details'] directly with a plain @foreach and never assumed exactly 24 rows, so it required zero changes for the entity-catalog v12 dynamic-add-row revision to PressingRecordService -- it correctly renders however many rows a record actually has, confirmed by grep (no '24' literal in the view)

REVISI (tech-spec v3, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): aksi verifikasi langsung di layar Detail (approve/un-approve, 2026-09-14) sebelumnya TIDAK terdokumentasi sama sekali di artefak ini. backend/app/Livewire/Data/DetailPressing.php memakai trait backend/app/Livewire/Data/Concerns/HandlesRecordVerification.php (verificationModelClass()=PressingRecord::class) dan blade-nya merender aksi lewat canCheck()/canAcknowledge() + :message=$verificationMessage — Checked By (Supervisor/Admin) dan Acknowledged By (Mill Management/Admin). Aksi memanggil backend/app/Services/RecordVerificationService.php::setVerification() (jalur tulis keempat): peran -> cakupan mill (403) -> assertPeriodOpenForWrite('pressing', mill stasiun record, `date` record) -> 422 PERIOD_CLOSED sebelum kolom berubah -> baru tulis checked_by/acknowledged_by. Sejak fix 0594c63 HandlesRecordVerification menangkap HttpException sehingga penolakan periode tampil sebagai alert $verificationMessage (sebelumnya 422 mentah). Padanan API: PATCH /api/records/{stationType}/{id}/verification (RecordVerificationController). Diuji: backend/tests/Feature/Livewire/DetailRecordVerificationTest.php ('kunci periode: ...'; trait bersama, diwakili DetailCagesTrack), backend/tests/Feature/Api/RecordVerificationTest.php (422 PERIOD_CLOSED setujui & batalkan), backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan whitelist).
